					<article class="post-entry post-entry-type-standard post-entry-3720 post-loop-1 post-parity-odd post-entry-last single-big with-slider post-3720 post type-post status-publish format-standard has-post-thumbnail hentry category-news"  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/BlogPosting" itemprop="blogPost" ><div class="big-preview single-big"  itemprop="image" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/ImageObject" ><a href="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot-1030x738.jpg"  title="Screenshot" ><img loading="lazy" width="845" height="321" src="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot-845x321.jpg" class="wp-image-3721 avia-img-lazy-loading-3721 attachment-entry_with_sidebar size-entry_with_sidebar wp-post-image" alt="Family kite Vacation" decoding="async" /></a></div><div class="blog-meta"></div><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix standard-content'><header class="entry-content-header"><h1 class='post-title entry-title '  itemprop="headline" >Family kite Vacation<span class="post-format-icon minor-meta"></span></h1><span class="post-meta-infos"><time class="date-container minor-meta updated"  itemprop="datePublished" datetime="2026-01-26T13:26:17-06:00" >January 26, 2026</time><span class="text-sep">/</span><span class="blog-categories minor-meta">in <a href="https://costakite.com/costa-rica/news/" rel="tag">News</a></span><span class="text-sep">/</span><span class="blog-author minor-meta">by <span class="entry-author-link"  itemprop="author" ><span class="author"><span class="fn"><a href="https://costakite.com/author/admin/" rel="author">CostaKite</a></span></span></span></span></span></header><div class="entry-content"  itemprop="text" ><h1>Family kite Vacation</h1>
<h4>Are you searching the best destination for a Family kite Vacation? Bahia Salinas in Costa Rica is your Spot!!</h4>
<p>Located just 1h15min from the closest airport (Liberia LIR), you will not need a long drive. Our spot is located right on the beach, so you can go kiting while the rest of the family relaxes on the pool of the <a href="https://www.nandel.com/">Nandel beach resort</a>. But if the whole family wants to go kiting, even better!! You can all enjoy our safe semi-private beach. Great grassy landing and lauchig area, beach showers, sun umbrellas, chairs.</p>
<div id="attachment_3721" style="width: 1189px" class="wp-caption aligncenter"><img decoding="async" aria-describedby="caption-attachment-3721" class="size-full wp-image-3721" src="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot.jpg" alt="Family kite Vacation" width="1179" height="845" srcset="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot.jpg 1179w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot-300x215.jpg 300w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot-1030x738.jpg 1030w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot-768x550.jpg 768w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot-600x430.jpg 600w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot-260x185.jpg 260w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-spot-705x505.jpg 705w" sizes="(max-width: 1179px) 100vw, 1179px" /><p id="caption-attachment-3721" class="wp-caption-text">Screenshot</p></div>
<p>If you want to take a break from kiting, just land your kite and have a snack or meal at our restaurant!</p>
<p>Check out the wind live form our weather station located at the beach: <a href="https://costakite.com/live-wind-in-bahia-salinas/">live wind</a></p>
<p>If you need to rent equipment, the Costa Kite team is onsite ready to give you the best service with the greatest gear.</p>
<p>If on the other hand you need lessons the team of instructors will get you riding safe with radio lessons.</p>
<p>This spot has it all for a Family kite Vacation!</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img decoding="async" class="aligncenter size-full wp-image-3722" src="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation.jpg" alt="Family kite Vacation" width="814" height="1006" srcset="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation.jpg 814w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-243x300.jpg 243w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-768x949.jpg 768w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-600x742.jpg 600w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Family-kite-Vacation-570x705.jpg 570w" sizes="(max-width: 814px) 100vw, 814px" /></p>
